entries.name: Liaquat Ali Khan
entries.summary: Pakistan ke pehle Wazir-e-Azam; Shaheed-e-Millat ke laqab se mashhoor.
facts: Objectives Resolution 7 March 1949 ko pesh ki; Assembly ne 12 March ko manzoor ki.
16 October 1951 ko Rawalpindi ke Company Bagh mein qatl hue; jagah baad mein Liaquat Bagh kehlai.
Hukoomati tenure lists mein office shuru hone ki tareekh 15 August 1947 hai; ise Independence Day, 14 August, se alag yaad rakhein.

entries.name: Khawaja Nazimuddin
entries.summary: Liaquat Ali Khan ke baad Pakistan ke doosre Wazir-e-Azam.
facts: Tarteeb yaad rakhein: Liaquat Ali Khan → Khawaja Nazimuddin → Muhammad Ali Bogra.
Yahan National Assembly ki tenure list aur parliamentary history ki 17 October 1951 wali tareekh li gayi hai; Cabinet ki purani summary mein 19 October likha hai.

entries.name: Muhammad Ali Bogra
entries.summary: Pakistan ke teesre Wazir-e-Azam; Chaudhry Muhammad Ali se mukhtalif shakhs hain.
facts: Bogra Formula / Constitutional Formula 7 October 1953 ko Constituent Assembly mein pesh kiya; do-house parliament aur East-West representation ka masla iska markaz tha.
24 October 1954 ko pehli Constituent Assembly tootne par bhi woh PM rahe; Cabinet dobara banai gayi.

entries.name: Chaudhry Muhammad Ali
entries.summary: Pakistan ke pehle Aaeen, 1956, ke waqt Wazir-e-Azam.
facts: 1956 ka Aaeen 23 March 1956 ko nafiz hua; Pakistan Islamic Republic bana.
Muhammad Ali Bogra un se pehle aur Huseyn Shaheed Suhrawardy un ke baad PM the.

entries.name: Huseyn Shaheed Suhrawardy
entries.summary: Pakistan ke paanchwein Wazir-e-Azam; 1956–1957 ka daur.
facts: Chaudhry Muhammad Ali ke baad aur I. I. Chundrigar se pehle PM rahe.
National Assembly ki list handover ki tareekh 18 October 1957 dikhati hai; Cabinet ki summary pichla din, 17 October, likhti hai.

entries.name: Ibrahim Ismail Chundrigar
entries.summary: I. I. Chundrigar: 1957 mein taqreeban do mahine PM rahe.
facts: Un ke baad Feroz Khan Noon aaye; chhoti muddat wale PM ke sawal mein naam pehchanein.
National Assembly 16 December 1957 handover dikhati hai; Cabinet ki summary mein 15 December hai.

entries.name: Feroz Khan Noon
entries.summary: 1958 ke pehle martial law se foran pehle Pakistan ke PM.
facts: Un ki premiership mein Pakistan ne September 1958 mein Gwadar Oman se khareeda; is naam ko Gwadar ke saath yaad rakhein.
7 October 1958 ko Aaeen mansookh aur assemblies dissolve huin; un ka daur khatam hua.
27 October 1958 Ayub Khan ke President banne ki tareekh hai, Noon ki PM muddat ka end nahin; Cabinet ki purani summary se is farq ka khayal rakhein.

entries.name: Nurul Amin (Noor-ul-Amin)
entries.summary: December 1971 mein sirf 13 din ke intehai mukhtasar daur ke PM.
facts: National Assembly ki rasmi list unhein PM tasleem karti hai; is liye un ka naam list se na chhorein.
1971 ki yeh muddat Zulfikar Ali Bhutto ke 1973 mein PM banne se alag hai.

entries.name: Zulfikar Ali Bhutto
entries.summary: 1973 ke Aaeen ke nafiz hone par Wazir-e-Azam bane.
facts: 20 December 1971 ko President bane the; PM ka halaf 14 August 1973 ko liya.
1977 ke election ke baad 28 March ko dobara halaf hua; musalsal PM service yahan aik range mein hai.
5 July 1977 ke martial law par un ki hukoomat khatam hui.

entries.name: Muhammad Khan Junejo
entries.summary: 1985 ke non-party elections ke baad Wazir-e-Azam bane.
facts: 24 March 1985 ko vote of confidence mila.
29 May 1988 ko President Zia-ul-Haq ne Article 58(2)(b) istemal karke Assembly dissolve ki.

entries.name: Benazir Bhutto
entries.summary: Pakistan aur kisi Muslim-majority mulk ki pehli khatoon Wazir-e-Azam; duniya ki pehli khatoon PM nahin.
facts: 1988 aur 1993 mein PM banin; dono muddatein alag yaad rakhein.
27 December 2007 un ki shahadat ki tareekh hai; us waqt woh serving PM nahin thin.

entries.name: Muhammad Nawaz Sharif
entries.summary: Teen martaba PM bane; 1993 ki bahali pehle daur ka hissa thi, chauthi elected term nahin.
facts: 18 April 1993 ki barkhastgi ke baad Supreme Court ne 26 May ko Assembly aur hukoomat bahal ki.
18 July 1993 ko phir Assembly dissolve hui. NA tenure table mein 8 July likha milta hai; yahan NA history aur Cabinet ke 18 July wale record ko follow kiya gaya hai.
28 May 1998 ke nuclear tests un ki doosri premiership mein hue.

entries.name: Mir Zafarullah Khan Jamali
entries.summary: 2002 ke elections ke baad parliamentary hukoomat ke Wazir-e-Azam.
facts: Un ka talluq Rojhan Jamali, Balochistan se tha; soobay aur PM ka naam jor kar yaad rakhein.
Un ke baad 2004 mein pehle Chaudhry Shujaat Hussain aur phir Shaukat Aziz PM bane.
Pervez Musharraf ka Chief Executive wala ohda PM se mukhtalif tha; use is PM list mein alag shakhs ke taur par nahin gina gaya.

entries.name: Chaudhry Shujaat Hussain

tenures.label: Cabinet ke handover record ke mutabiq

entries.summary: Jamali aur Shaukat Aziz ke darmiyan 2004 mein mukhtasar muddat ke elected PM; caretaker nahin.
facts: Cabinet ka tafseeli record 30 June se 28 August 2004 tak hai; usi din Shaukat Aziz ne office sambhala.
NA summary end 26 August, aur Cabinet ki purani summary resignation 25 August / continuation 27 August likhti hai; is farq ki wajah se exact duration ke MCQ mein source/context zaroor dekhein.

entries.name: Shaukat Aziz
entries.summary: Chaudhry Shujaat Hussain ke baad 2004–2007 mein Wazir-e-Azam.
facts: Shujaat ki Cabinet mein Finance aur Revenue ka portfolio rakhte the.
Un ke baad Muhammad Mian Soomro caretaker PM bane.

entries.name: Syed Yousaf Raza Gillani

tenures.label: Amali service; retrospective disqualification neeche dekhein

entries.summary: 2008 ke elections ke baad PM; 2012 ki adalati na-ahli se mutalliq aham naam.
facts: 19 June 2012 ko Supreme Court ka faisla aya; na-ahli 26 April 2012 se moassar qarar di gayi.
Is liye Cabinet 19 June end dikhata hai, jabke NA ki tenure table 25 April tak likhti hai. Faisle ki tareekh aur moassar tareekh alag hain.

entries.name: Raja Pervez Ashraf
entries.summary: Yousaf Raza Gillani ke baad 22 June 2012 ko PM bane.
facts: 2013 mein un ke baad Mir Hazar Khan Khoso caretaker PM bane.
Assembly ki paanch saala muddat 16 March 2013 ko khatam hui; PM ki service aur Assembly ki muddat ki tareekhein aik nahin.

entries.name: Shahid Khaqan Abbasi
entries.summary: 2017 mein Nawaz Sharif ke baad PM; caretaker nahin the.
facts: 31 May 2018 ko daur khatam hua; 1 June ko Nasir-ul-Mulk ne caretaker PM ka halaf liya.

entries.name: Imran Khan
entries.summary: 2018–2022 ke PM; 1992 Cricket World Cup jeetne wali Pakistan team ke captain bhi the.
facts: 10 April 2022 ko un ke khilaf no-confidence resolution 174 votes se manzoor hui.
Cricket World Cup ki jeet 1992 ki hai, PM banne ka saal 2018 hai.

entries.name: Mian Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif
entries.summary: 21 October 2026 ki verification par Pakistan ke mojooda Wazir-e-Azam.
facts: 2024 mein Assembly ne 3 March ko muntakhib kiya; halaf 4 March ko liya. Yahan tenure oath date se hai.
NA ki list 3 March se shuru karti hai; Pakistan Consulate ki rasmi profile 4 March ka halaf tasdeeq karti hai.
2022–2023 ke pehle daur aur 2024 se shuru doosre daur ke beech Kakar ki caretaker hukoomat thi.

entries.name: Ghulam Mustafa Jatoi
entries.summary: Pakistan ke pehle caretaker Wazir-e-Azam, 1990.
facts: Benazir Bhutto ke pehle daur ke baad aur Nawaz Sharif ke pehle daur se pehle aaye.
Yahan NA ki 6 November tareekh hai; Cabinet ki mukhtasar list end 5 November likhti hai.

entries.name: Mir Balakh Sher Mazari
entries.summary: 1993 ki barkhastgi ke darmiyan caretaker PM; Nawaz Sharif ki bahali par daur khatam hua.
facts: 26 May 1993 ko Supreme Court ne Assembly bahal ki; Nawaz Sharif phir PM bane.
1993 mein do mukhtalif caretakers aaye: pehle Mazari, baad mein Moeen Qureshi.

entries.name: Moeen Qureshi (Moin Qureshi)
entries.summary: 1993 ke doosre caretaker PM; World Bank ke Senior Vice President reh chuke the.
facts: 18 July 1993 Cabinet ka tafseeli record hai; NA ki summary mein 8 July likha hai, jo parliamentary history se mail nahin khata.
Un ke baad 19 October 1993 ko Benazir Bhutto ka doosra daur shuru hua.

entries.name: Malik Meraj Khalid
entries.summary: Benazir Bhutto ke doosre daur ke baad 1996–1997 mein caretaker PM.
facts: National Assembly ke Speaker bhi reh chuke the; 1988 mein Speaker muntakhib hue.
Cabinet ke record mein shuruat 5 November hai; NA ki tenure summary 6 November likhti hai. Yahan Cabinet ki tareekh istemal hui hai.

entries.name: Muhammad Mian Soomro
entries.summary: Shaukat Aziz ke baad 2007–2008 ke caretaker PM; Senate Chairman bhi rahe.
facts: National Assembly aur Cabinet ki mukhtasar PM list 24 March 2008 tak service dikhati hain; Gillani ka halaf agle din hua.
Unhein 2018 ke caretaker Nasir-ul-Mulk se mix na karein.

entries.name: Justice (Retd) Mir Hazar Khan Khoso
entries.summary: 2013 ke caretaker PM; Balochistan High Court aur Federal Shariat Court ke Chief Justice rahe.
facts: Raja Pervez Ashraf ke baad aaye; Nawaz Sharif ke 5 June 2013 ke halaf par handover hua.
Cabinet ki mukhtasar list end 4 June dikhati hai; yahan NA ki 5 June tareekh hai.

entries.name: Justice (Retd) Nasir-ul-Mulk
entries.summary: 2018 ke caretaker PM; Pakistan ke sabiq Chief Justice.
facts: 1 June 2018 ko President Mamnoon Hussain ne halaf liya.
Shahid Khaqan Abbasi ke baad aur Imran Khan se pehle caretaker PM rahe.

entries.name: Anwaar-ul-Haq Kakar

tenures.label: Shehbaz Sharif ke halaf par handover

entries.summary: 2023–2024 ke caretaker PM; Shehbaz Sharif ke dono dauron ke darmiyan aaye.
facts: 14 August 2023 ko President Arif Alvi ne halaf liya.
NA summary end 3 March 2024 dikhati hai, jab naya PM muntakhib hua; yahan 4 March ko naye PM ke halaf par handover dikhaya gaya hai.
